title: Brian Gutekunst: We weren't sure how Dontayvion Wicks would "fit into our future plans"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Brian Gutekunst: We weren't sure how Dontayvion Wicks would "fit into our future plans"
sources.description: The Packers traded receiver Dontayvion Wicks to the Eagles earlier this month, receiving a 2026 fifth-round pick and a 2027 sixth-round pick in exchange for the receiver.
